title: StreamForge 4.5 TLS advisory
content: StreamForge 4.5 deployments should rotate the bundled TLS trust store before the next maintenance window. The issue affects encrypted control-plane connections, not worker process stability.

title: StreamForge 4.6 worker tuning guide
content: Worker concurrency and graceful shutdown intervals can be adjusted for high-throughput installations. Track queue depth and shutdown duration when changing worker counts.

title: StreamForge 4.7 heap behavior change
content: StreamForge 4.7 changed memory reuse behavior for long-lived workers. The release note recommends monitoring resident memory during rolling upgrades; it does not identify a known crash condition.

title: StreamForge 4.8 compatibility bulletin
content: StreamForge 4.8 supports the current Linux LTS releases and the documented container runtimes. Validate extension compatibility before upgrading production workers.

title: StreamForge 4.8 runtime migration notes
content: The 4.8 branch updates worker-runtime components and adds additional allocator telemetry. Review the compatibility matrix for native extensions and collect worker diagnostics when a process exits unexpectedly.

title: Connection-pool exhaustion incident
content: A customer API tier experienced elevated latency after exhausting its database connection pool. Worker processes remained healthy; queue delay tracked active connection count.

title: Worker timeout postmortem
content: A worker timeout was traced to a downstream service exceeding its request deadline. Raising the timeout alone hid the symptom, while correcting the dependency latency resolved it.

title: Linux allocator troubleshooting
content: For intermittent native process exits, preserve a core file and compare allocator diagnostics with application logs. Memory pressure and invalid native extension access can produce superficially similar symptoms.

title: Object storage replication advisory
content: Delayed replication in one storage region can increase recovery point age. No worker runtime or application process changes are required.

title: Network route maintenance notice
content: A route update may briefly interrupt connections to the analytics subnet. Applications should reconnect using the standard retry policy.

title: StreamForge 4.4 logging reference
content: Worker logs include lifecycle events, task identifiers, and graceful-stop reasons. Log rotation should retain at least one complete deployment window.

title: StreamForge 4.6 queue backpressure note
content: Backpressure limits protect worker pools when producers outpace consumers. A saturated queue generally causes delayed work rather than abrupt process termination.

title: Container memory limit checklist
content: Compare container memory limits with observed resident set size and restart history. An enforced memory limit can terminate a process without an application-level exception.

title: Customer report: delayed jobs after patching
content: After a routine patch, one customer saw jobs remain queued for several minutes. Increasing worker count restored throughput; no process exits appeared in the host journal.

title: StreamForge extension compatibility matrix
content: Native extensions should be rebuilt against the runtime ABI documented for each supported StreamForge minor release. Unsupported extensions can fail during load or task execution.

title: Regional DNS resolution incident
content: Intermittent DNS resolution failures delayed outbound requests in one region. The incident was mitigated by restoring the resolver pool; worker processes stayed online.

title: Metrics collector upgrade guide
content: Collector upgrades can rename histogram labels. Dashboards should be checked for missing series after rollout; the collector runs separately from StreamForge workers.

title: StreamForge 4.3 worker shutdown advisory
content: A shutdown race in an older 4.3 build could delay termination while active jobs drained. The issue was addressed in a maintenance release and differs from unexpected exits during normal processing.

title: Filesystem inode pressure runbook
content: Low inode availability can prevent temporary files from being created. Check filesystem utilization and kernel logs when jobs fail to stage local data.

title: Customer report: intermittent worker restarts
content: A customer observed worker restarts during a deployment window but found no common task pattern. Host memory pressure and orchestrator eviction events were still under investigation.

title: StreamForge 4.8 plugin migration checklist
content: Before enabling a plugin on 4.8, verify its supported runtime ABI and test it with representative workloads. Capture the plugin inventory alongside worker logs if a rollout needs investigation.

title: Message broker certificate rotation
content: Broker certificate rotation caused several clients to reconnect. The event affected connection availability and did not change local worker memory behavior.

title: CPU throttling operations note
content: Sustained CPU throttling can increase task duration and trigger external deadlines. Compare container throttled time with application latency before changing worker concurrency.

title: StreamForge 4.5 configuration migration
content: The 4.5 configuration parser accepts the legacy worker-count key for compatibility. New installations should use the current worker pool setting.

title: Backup catalog indexing delay
content: A catalog index rebuild delayed search results for backup operators. Restore operations and the StreamForge execution tier were unaffected.

title: Kernel OOM event guide
content: The kernel OOM log records processes selected after a memory limit is exceeded. Correlate timestamps with container restarts before attributing termination to application code.

title: StreamForge worker health endpoint
content: The health endpoint reports readiness and active task count. It does not retain the reason for a process that has already exited.

title: Customer report: native module load failure
content: A native module built for an earlier runtime ABI failed during startup after an upgrade. Rebuilding the module against the installed headers restored service.

title: Time synchronization troubleshooting
content: Clock drift can complicate correlation across hosts. Compare NTP status and normalize timestamps before joining application and infrastructure logs.

title: StreamForge 4.8 rollout checklist
content: Roll out 4.8 gradually, verify extension compatibility, and compare worker restart rates against the previous build. Keep application logs and runtime metrics for each canary interval.

title: Queue visibility timeout explanation
content: A visibility timeout can cause a task to be delivered again when processing takes longer than expected. It affects task duplication, not the worker process lifecycle.

title: Storage volume latency report
content: An overloaded volume caused slow checkpoint writes and elevated job durations. No worker exits were recorded, and replacing the volume resolved the issue.
